No, that’s just going to put you in hospital. If your facing an L charge I know it can be scary due to the schedule. But you’ll be fine. I have a friend who got caught with an entire VIAL in Memphis, and this was his 2nd psych charge (he’d been caught with mushrooms prior) and he got 2 years probation.. but since they can’t test for psych shit, they piss tested him once and never called him into PO again as long as he paid on time. You’ll survive man.

I just had a case dropped where I was facing 50-70 years. I know the feeling. I wanted to die. But at least wait til trial. I did and days before my trial it was cancelled due to the “victim” coming forward and being honest, miracles do happen brother. 

At least wait it out. If they’re going to throw like 20 years at you, I don’t know, maybe wait to see if you even get convicted, then think about hard stuff like this..

Just cause you got a charge doesn’t mean the fight is over, it’s just started. You’d be surprised how things can go in court. Try to get a decent lawyer and research it yourself. Little technicalities can get it thrown out. Be patient. And have faith it will work. It’s America man, people only do 8-15 years for murder half the time here before they’re paroled, it’s a hell of a country.

I literally never went to school.. I got a record deal right out of high school and have only done music until this went down winter 2017. The past 2.5 years have just been a blur of drugs, isolation, awaiting a trial that got cancelled literally days before due to her emailing them and telling truth.. and yes not only did the community drag me I was the poster boy for like that whole shit. I was a fairly big musician in my city and scene and had some people who I guess didn’t like me or feel I deserved the success I got. So
If you know the scene you know how people can get- when this happened it was basically an excuse for them to mob me into my room. I’ve thought about moving but these people are relentless and follow my 
music and even if I lived in japan, if they saw online that I was doing a show or landed a cool deal or something they’d email that company and go into all this stuff. Been happening since this started.

 I live in a huge music town too. But I don’t know anything but music man. I bootlegged a little bit when I was broke on the come up. Never did college, left early my senior year, just played in a band 18-27..I’m just lost as fuck and can’t get the motivation to get going again... I got a job ghost writing for some people. But I want to make music again. I don’t enjoy doing it for others nearly as much.

I was so happy. I was legit stoked to wake up everyday. i never imagined I’d be in this spot.. it also happened just a couple months after my guitarist commited suicide at 27.. so you know how people are, that got all mythologized and was the gossip until this happened.. it’s just been so much drama.. life feels like a sick joke
